navaid.name: U.S. Coast Guard - Sector Southeastern New England
navaid.description: Sector Southeastern New England’s area of responsibility covers over 3,000 square miles of offshore waters & 1,200 miles of coastline of Rhode Island and Southeastern Massachusetts, including Cape Cod and the Islands.
